messages:
maya: heads up — staging canary for model rdx-7b-awq started stalling ~30m in. pattern looks like group_size=96 + act-quant ON. requests queue up, batcher stops flushing.
jas: @maya do you have the trace or a log snippet?
oliver: pasting the tail of the worker log we captured:```
[2026-03-18T22:10:12Z] batcher: waiting_for_group (group_id=7, size=96)
[2026-03-18T22:10:17Z] kv_cache: expected_prefix_len=512 got=504 -> mismatch, retrying
[2026-03-18T22:10:22Z] serve: worker-3 stall_detected, inflight=12, kv_hits=0
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"/srv/runtime/serve.py\", line 412, in _process_batch
    out = self.model.decode(batch)
  File \"/srv/runtime/model_awq.py\", line 221, in decode
    raise RuntimeError(\"group decode timeout\")
RuntimeError: group decode timeout
```
benchbot: bakeoff-run 1956789000 finished — quick summary: AWQ gsz=96 actq=ON: MMLU -3.2%, HellaSwag -1.4%, Winogrande -0.8%. gsz=32 actq=OFF: MMLU -0.1%, HellaSwag +0.2%. full CSV uploaded to //bench/store/rdx-awq-sweep-1956789000.csv
jas: overnight sweep results (high-level): gsz 16/32 stable, 64 flaky (sporadic stalls), 96 consistently hitting the stall path when act-quant enabled. CPU/IO looks fine — issue local to AWQ group handling.
maya: config used in canary for reproduction:```yaml
model: rdx-7b-awq
quant: AWQ
act_quant: true
group_size: 96
kv_cache: prefix
autoscale: disabled
```
zara: recommend immediate rollback to a safer profile for prod canary: group_size=32, act_quant=false. also add a liveness probe on batcher latency > 5s to force restart. filing rollback now.
oliver: opened PR to add a soft-flush: if batcher_wait>2500ms and not full_group -> flush partial group and attach group_metadata to response to aid debugging. PR: https://git.redwood/rdx/runtime/pulls/478 (wip)
maya: tried retrying with gsz=64+actq=OFF — no stalls for 2h, minor accuracy hit on our internal prompts (~0.6% on target metric).
jas: re-run evals on the recent canary prompt set:```
gsz=96 actq=ON: mrr_drop=4.1%, safety_failures x2
gsz=32 actq=OFF: mrr_drop=0.3%, safety_failures baseline
```
deploy-bot: rollback by zara initiated for canary group rdx-7b-awq -> target profile gsz=32 actq=OFF. status: in_progress
zara: added alert: "serve.awq.batcher_stall" -> page on 3 occurrences within 5m. also added runbook note to disable act-quant immediately if batcher stalls.
maya: thanks — i'll keep a trace capture running on the rolled-back canary and start a focused AWQ debugging session tomorrow. cc @oliver @jas
jas: plan for tomorrow: 1) reproduce locally with synthetic prefix length variance, 2) bisect act-quant code path (activation scale clamping), 3) add unit test for partial-group flush.
oliver: also adding a metric: percent_partial_flushes / minute so we can correlate with eval deltas.
maya: ack. i'll tag the bench CSV to the incident: //incidents/1956789012/bench.csv
jas: :thumbsup:
maya: thanks everyone — monitoring until rollback finishes.
